info.description: The Pharmacy Prescriptions Delivery API enables authorized users to retrieve detailed information about pharmacy prescriptions deliveries. This API supports requests for the status, tracking, and specifics of prescription deliveries, facilitating better communication between pharmacies and patients. Typical consumers of this API include pharmacy management systems, delivery services, and healthcare providers who need to monitor and manage prescription delivery workflows. By utilizing this API, users can ensure timely and accurate delivery of medications to patients.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details regarding prescription deliveries, including status, estimated delivery time, and any associated notes.
